title: Half a Million Waited in the Desert for the Pope 🇵🇪 #shorts
desc:
On Nov 13, 2026, Pope Leo XIV returned to Chiclayo, Peru, where he served as bishop from 2015 to 2023. About a million people lined the streets, and the Vatican estimated about 500,000 attended his outdoor Mass at the Pampas de Pimentel, with temperatures reaching 90°F. The crowd chanted "¡El Papa es chiclayano!" Born in Chicago, he became a Peruvian citizen in 2015.

Sources: Vatican News, OSV News, EWTN News, America Magazine.
